summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $315M from $167M.
The net loss widened to $300M, or −$4.66 per share, from $152M. Operating cash flow was −$241M and free cash flow −$242M, versus −$136M.

risks: We have completed a limited number of clinical trials for our lead product candidate, atacicept, and have no products approved for commercial sale…
We have incurred net losses since inception, and have never generated revenue from product sales
We are substantially dependent on the success of our product candidates
